dashboard.label: Cyber Data Catalog - Coverage Gaps, Cost and Lifecycle
dashboard.description: What the six-domain model requires vs what exists, what it costs, and what is safe to retire.

search.query: | inputlookup dc_requirement_coverage_lookup | chart count over ae_name by status
| inputlookup dc_requirement_coverage_lookup | stats count(eval(status="COVERED")) as covered, count as total by domain | eval coverage_pct=round(covered/total*100,1) | sort coverage_pct

panel.title: Required telemetry with no coverage - the gap register

search.query: | inputlookup dc_requirement_coverage_lookup where status="GAP - REQUIRED" | table ae_name uhgid req_id domain gap_reason | sort ae_name req_id

| inputlookup dc_cost_lookup where scope_type="dataset" | eval category=case(disposition="DUPLICATE SPEND - cutover pending","Duplicate (dual-home)",disposition="DECOMMISSION CANDIDATE","Dead Tier 3 data",disposition="review - no consumers","Unconsumed data",1=1,"Productive") | stats sum(gb_per_day) as gb_per_day, sum(est_annual_cost) as est_annual_cost, dc(scope_id) as datasets by category | sort - est_annual_cost

| inputlookup dc_datasets_lookup | where status="active" | join type=left dataset_id [| inputlookup dc_dependencies_lookup where dep_type="dataset" | rename dep_value as dataset_id | lookup dc_ko_lookup ko_id OUTPUT ko_tier enabled | where enabled="yes" | stats dc(ko_id) as consumers, dc(eval(if(ko_tier="Tier 0",ko_id,null()))) as tier0_consumers by dataset_id] | fillnull value=0 consumers tier0_consumers | stats count as datasets, sum(tier0_consumers) as tier0_dependencies, sum(consumers) as content_dependencies, sum(eval(if(isnull(technical_owner) OR technical_owner="",1,0))) as unowned by uhgid, ae_name | eval readiness=case(tier0_dependencies>0,"BLOCKED - Tier 0 dependency",content_dependencies>0,"review - repoint content",unowned>0,"review - unowned datasets",1=1,"ready to offboard") | table ae_name uhgid datasets content_dependencies tier0_dependencies unowned readiness | sort readiness

format.colorPalette: {"BLOCKED - Tier 0 dependency":#DC4E41,"review - repoint content":#F8BE34,"review - unowned datasets":#F1813F,"ready to offboard":#53A051}

search.query: | inputlookup dc_cost_lookup where scope_type="dataset" | lookup dc_datasets_lookup dataset_id as scope_id OUTPUT ae_name sourcetype | table scope_id ae_name sourcetype declared_tier gb_per_day est_annual_cost consumer_count disposition | sort - est_annual_cost
